EC1: - Pedunculated polyps (as defined by Paris Classification type Ip)
EC2: - Suspected adenocarcinoma with deep submucosal invasion
EC3: - Patients with ulcerated depressed lesions (as defined by Paris Classification type III) [OR] or confirmed adenocarcinoma
EC5: - Patients who are receiving an emergency colonoscopy
EC7: - Patients with coagulopathy [AND] with an elevated INR ≥1.5, [OR] or platelets <50
EC8: - Inadequate bowel preparation (Boston Bowel Prep Scale, total score ≤2)
